admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Administrator account with permissions to manage students, videos, attendance, exams, and other admins.

isSuperAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the admin is a super admin

student.title: Student
student.description: Student account containing academics, attendance metrics, custom notes, and security state.

id.description: Unique phone number of the student

phone.description: Login phone number for student access

parentPhone.description: Login phone number for parent access

academicYear.description: ID of the student's current academic year

enabled.description: Flag indicating if the account is active

notes.description: Private administrative or academic notes about this student

attendance_record.title: Attendance Record
attendance_record.description: A single day attendance logging for a student.

studentName.description: Name of the student for easier rendering

grade_record.title: Grade Record
grade_record.description: An exam result scorecard for a student.

examName.description: Name of the exam or test

examDate.description: Date when the exam was held

totalMarks.description: Maximum marks possible for this exam

studentName.description: Name of the student for easier rendering

video.title: Video
video.description: Video detail linked to Cloudflare Stream with playback attributes.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to the preview thumbnail image

academicYear.description: Academic year ID required to access this video

signedUrl.description: Whether signed URL playback is mandatory

academic_year.title: Academic Year
academic_year.description: An academic session grouping students and material.

name.description: Label of the year, e.g. 'Class of 2025'

group.title: Group
group.description: Numbered male or female school group associated with an academic year.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Notification broadcast metadata logged for user tracking.

bookmark.title: Bookmark
bookmark.description: A saved video timestamp with optional notes or descriptions created by a student.

studentPhone.description: Phone number of the student who created this bookmark

videoId.description: ID of the video this bookmark belongs to

timestamp.description: The exact time in seconds in the video

note.description: Optional note or title for the bookmark

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the bookmark was created

/admins/{adminId}.description: List of administrators with authentication and role credentials.

/students/{studentId}.description: List of active and inactive students.

/attendance/{attendanceId}.description: Global list of attendance markers linked to student phone numbers.

/grades/{gradeId}.description: Global registry of exam scoring papers.

/videos/{videoId}.description: Educational lecture materials streamed via Cloudflare.

/groups/{groupId}.description: Academic year sub-groups for male and female students.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: History of alerts issued by admins.

/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Student video bookmarks for saved timestamps.
